definitions.explanation: the state of being lazy or unwilling to work or make effort

examples.japanese: {怠惰|たいだ}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
{怠惰|たいだ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧だ。
examples.english: Laziness is the enemy of success.

examples.japanese: {怠惰|たいだ}な⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}えたい→変える：01089_kaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っている→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I want to change my lazy self.

notes:
USAGE:
- {怠惰|たいだ}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ (idle life)
- {怠惰|たいだ}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (lazy person)
- {怠惰|たいだ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧ (to spend time idly)
A formal, somewhat literary word. Carries moral judgment - implies laziness as a character flaw or vice.

RELIGIOUS CONTEXT:
One of the Seven Deadly Sins in Christian tradition (sloth).
